SectionObject.Title: Year 1931
SectionObject.Text1:
Historical orthophoto

Photo taken at a right angle to the ground. Depending on technology and the passing of time, matching to the map is not perfect, since ground conditions may have changed, among other things.
SectionObject.Text2: It can be difficult to interpret older images, since they differ a lot from the model. Look carefully at the harbour area. There have been major changes over the years.
